claim_boundary.exact: finite state/gate algebra, all-order closure, and tiny marked geometry checks
claim_boundary.not_ruled_out: mean insertion sources themselves, couplings to observers varying inside a fixed q sector, or continuum identification from independent modular data

finite_algebra.matrix_convention: columns are images of basis vectors

current_fields_sufficient_for: all f(q) couplings to unmarked S/D
all f(q) couplings to lifted-line chi4 S/D
all f(q) couplings to same-root local-landing H4 S/D
contact subtraction using q,q2,J_S,J_D and q_before*J_D

external_classes.bulk_Betti_observer: component/cycle counts or Euler/Betti density that varies within a fixed ambient-rank q sector
external_classes.charged_seam_observer: signed/character-valued seam crossing, winding charge, or defect partition observable resolving states within the same q sector
external_classes.local_landing_observer: landing or arm/motif value at a separately sampled site or separation, not merely a mark multiplying the same root gate
external_classes.modular_or_shape_observer: independent stress/KdV response or wrapping channel not determined by ambient rank alone

minimal_missing_statistics: O_ext and O_ext^2 per microcanonical k/batch
O_ext*J_D4 and O_ext*J_S4 on the same configuration
for field Gram: two-root J_D4*conj(J_S4) and |J_S4|^2
root/separation metadata when O_ext is local
seam charge and orientation phase when O_ext is charged

scientific_card: MECHANISM SPACE: every q-only connected insertion response collapses to a four-dimensional gate algebra.
NOT PROVED: the theorem says nothing about observers that resolve configurations within one q sector.
OBSERVER-SECTOR-SOURCE-GEOMETRY: f(q) | ambient-rank topology | arbitrary marked S/D gate polynomial | any finite torus.
DEPENDENCY GROUP: previous A_top/J_D and q2 orthogonal scores are corollaries, not independent evidence.
UPWEIGHT OBSERVATION: an independent bulk, separated-local, or charged-seam observer with same-field source products.

theorem.all_order_reason: Q*(Q-1)*(Q+1)=0 reduces arbitrary polynomial, analytic, or lookup-table f to degree at most two
theorem.marked_source: X=H(environment)*G(S,D), with H independent of root occupation and G(0,0)=0
theorem.no_go: topology-only f(q) cannot supply an independent field matrix element against any root-occupation-independent marked insertion source
